info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Banking Accounts Statements-v2-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of banking account statements for users. By providing access to detailed transaction records, account holders can efficiently monitor their financial activities and generate necessary reports. Typical consumers include personal banking users, financial analysts, and business operations teams who require up-to-date statement information. Additionally, it supports use cases in reconciliation processes and financial audits, enhancing transparency and financial management.

get.description: Fetch the statements associated with a specific account. This endpoint allows you to access detailed statement information for your financial management.

requestBody.description: The request body required to retrieve account statements. It should contain the necessary parameters to filter and structure the statements being requested.

200.description: The request was successfully completed and the account statements have been retrieved.

ListBankingAccountsStatementsRequest.description: The request body for retrieving account statements via a GET operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the operation.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message related to the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the operation.

ListBankingAccountsStatementsResponse_20.description: Response schema for fetching account statements operations. Provides information about the operation's status, reference numbers, and additional metadata.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit information for the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request. A value of 0 signifies that the request was processed instantly.
